text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day leading up to the Takarazuka 
Kinen, Admire Vega came with Meisho Doto 
to watch the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On that stage where powerhouses gathered, 
T.M. Opera O, cloaked in an extraordinary 
aura, loudly declared "the beginning of a 
new chapter."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The run she delivered in the actual race 
was truly fierce. And after the race, she 
spoke directly to Meisho Doto in the 
stands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I was waiting only for you"—that 
declaration served as the final push for 
Meisho Doto to finally break out of her 
shell after a long, long period of 
preparation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto dashes off to train. Watching 
her, Admire Vega also feels inspired and 
says she wants to go for a run too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At last, all four stood together. The 
excitement of the Senior Class was only 
just beginning. It felt like a herald of 
what was to come.
